reuse.why: It extracts one selection helper and points all five month-wide actions at it, removing the three copied SQL queries and the separate hidden check in copyPreviousMonth.

duplication.why: The hidden/hidden-group/template exclusion is now defined once in getMonthWideActionCategories; the old copies are deleted.

placement.why: The selection helper sits in budget/actions.ts beside getBudgetData, where the tree keeps budget-action queries.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their category query and focused tests change; single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: Clear and well named; copyPreviousMonth now intersects its budget rows with an id set from a second query, which is slightly indirect but keeps the rule in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action uses getMonthWideActionCategories; none keeps its own exclusion query.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the per-action queries were removed rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: getMonthWideActionCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg.
